NVIDIA's research and development expense rose about 38.2% from fiscal Q1 2026 to fiscal Q4 2026.

- **Fiscal Q1 2026** (quarter ended Apr 27, 2025): R&D was $3,989 million, taken from the comparative column of the latest 10-Q.
- **Fiscal Q4 2026** (quarter ended Jan 25, 2026): the filings do not give this quarter directly, so I subtracted the nine-month R&D figure ($12,985 million, 10-Q for the quarter ended Oct 26, 2025) from the full-year figure ($18,497 million, 10-K). That gives $5,512 million.
- **Change:** (5,512 − 3,989) / 3,989 = 1,523 / 3,989 ≈ 38.2%.
